name: Median Filter Denoising
definition: A post-processing technique used to reduce 'Salt and Pepper' noise caused by unpredictable precision errors in raycasting that result in wrong or missing pixel colors.
summary: Median Filter Denoising is a post-processing technique that removes single-pixel salt and pepper noise by replacing each pixel with the median color of its 3x3 neighborhood, distinguishing itself from weighted blurs by targeting extreme outliers.
